pages.intro: This is an example custom page. Edit or delete it from the CMS, and add your own pages — each one automatically gets a grid view and individual detail pages, just like Team and Portfolio. Add a menu item pointing to 'custom-page.html?slug=your-slug' to link it from the navigation.
